text: CLI-driven workflow to initialize, start, run a query against, and stop a local HelixDB instance
quote: Initialize HelixDB, start a local instance, run the generated query, and stop it

text: Runs as an embedded database, in-process, with memory, disk, or object storage backends
quote: Embedded database — run the same engine and queries in process with memory, disk, or object storage.

text: Vector indexes rank node or edge embeddings by distance with configurable dimension and distance metric
quote: Vector indexes rank node or edge embeddings by distance. Every definition requires a non-zero dimension and a distance metric.

text: Built-in text indexes provide durable BM25 keyword search over string properties
quote: Text indexes provide durable BM25 search over string properties on nodes or edges.

text: Graph traversal and filtering narrow the candidate set before vector ranking, keeping results within graph/permission boundaries
quote: traverse and filter an exact candidate set before vector ranking, so results cannot escape graph or permission boundaries.

text: Unified operation-tree request model shared across Rust, TypeScript, Go, and Python SDKs
quote: HelixDB v3 uses one operation-tree request model across the Rust, TypeScript, Go, and Python SDKs.

text: Cloud offering provides row-level isolation so any tenancy model can be built at the application layer
quote: Helix Cloud focuses on row-level isolation, which lets you implement any tenancy model at the application layer without structural constraints on the database.

text: MCP tool executes an exact v3 read-query JSON request, gated by a read permission scope
quote: helix_execute_read_query: execute exact v3 request_type: "read" JSON; requires database.query.read.

text: ACID transactions span graph, vector, and text data within a single transaction
quote: ACID transactions across graph, vector, and text data in a single transaction.

text: Search and filtering capabilities apply to both nodes and edges, not just nodes
quote: Search and filtering on both nodes and edges, not just nodes.

text: Role-based access control with scoped API keys offering read-only, read-write, or operation-restricted permissions
quote: Role-based access control. Scoped API keys with read-only, read-write, or operation-restricted permissions for least-privilege credentials per service or environment.

text: One-shot bootstrapper installs query skills and a docs MCP server, scaffolds a project, and seeds example data
quote: helix chef is an interactive, one-shot bootstrapper. It installs the HelixDB query skills and docs MCP, scaffolds a project, starts a local instance, seeds some example data

text: Source code is Apache 2.0 licensed and developed openly on GitHub
quote: Open source: Apache 2.0 licensed and developed in the open on GitHub.

text: Database-specific overrides can adjust request rate limits, burst capacity, and query retry budget
quote: Database-specific overrides can change the sustained rate, burst capacity, and query attempt budget.
